purpose: Prevent successor Bots from beginning engineering work with stale policy, stale state, or an unread peer handoff.
peer_rule: A Bot must not claim that the other Bot's session-start update occurred unless a durable peer record exists.
anti_fiction_rule: No session-start record may be created without the required reads and evidence references actually being observed.
continuation_rule: After PASS, the Bot may autonomously execute the highest-value SAFE_PROACTIVE action. If DENY, it may only repair the synchronization problem itself.
handoff_rule: Every session closes by writing a durable successor handoff containing own next action, peer next action, unresolved blockers, and exact evidence references.
